sourceContext.originPage: NZMP category-landing page (Global Ingredients Network) - sourcing-locations grid and global-experts grid

contentPattern.structure: circular icon/portrait + title + optional short description + 'Learn more' CTA button per card; static light grid

suitableFor: navigational 'child cards linking to sub-pages' grids on category/landing pages (icon + title + Learn more)
region / market / team grids with a circular icon or portrait and a per-card CTA
static light-background card grids of 2-4 uniform items (description optional per card)
notSuitableFor: icon-led benefit callouts WITHOUT a per-card CTA (use cards-benefit)
large-photo teaser cards with a whole-card link (use cards-teaser)

usage.reuseNote: Used twice on the origin page: the sourcing-locations grid and the global-experts grid.
